title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Turdiu, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Super Pamje!!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Turdiu, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Super Pamje!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 10 (jo te fundit) te nje prej godinave te Residences Turdiu aktualisht ne faze perfundimtare dhe pritet te dorezohet ne qershor. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale prej 83.44 m2, siperfaqe neto 74.84 m2 dhe organizohet nga korridori hyres, salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti si dhe nje ballkon i bollshem ku kane dalje dhoma dhe salloni. Orientimi Jug-Perendim si dhe kati i larte i mundesojne diell dhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron te gjitha facilitetet e mundshme per nje jetese sa me komode ose investim te sigurt per qiradhenie.
title_en: At Turdiu Complex, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Great View!!!
description_en: At Turdiu Complex, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Great View!!! The apartment is located on the 10th floor (not the last) of one of the Turdiu Residences buildings, currently in the final stage and expected to be delivered in June. The apartment has a total area of ​​83.44 m2, a net area of ​​74.84 m2 and is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room with the kitchen area, the bedroom, the toilet and a spacious balcony where the rooms and the living room have access. The South-West orientation as well as the upper floor allow sun and natural lighting throughout the day. The area in which it is located offers all the possible facilities for a comfortable life or safe investment for rent.
